requirements: R1: Ensure AuthController.getJwkProvider throws a system error on URL/initialization failure instead of swallowing it and returning null.
R2: Ensure fetchOidcProfile performs strict OIDC cryptographic signature verification before decoding claims with JWT.decode.
R3: Implement knowledge-grade assertions in JwkValidationTest to verify correct behavior instead of a placeholder.
R4: Implement the complex functional product requirements flagged in the audit, including Moodle role synchronization and course-based access control.

slices.title: Resolve Authentication Cryptography and Role Sync Falsification Findings
slices.jtbd: When implementing the falsification fixes for this epic, I want to repair the JWT verification, implement real validation tests, and ensure role synchronization is executed, so that the self-falsification loop is closed and security requirements are met.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an OIDC token during authentication
When the signature is validated
Then the system must cryptographically verify it before reading claims and throw an error if the JWK provider fails to initialize.
Given the JwkValidationTest is executed
When the assertions are evaluated
Then the test must contain explicit, non-stubbed assertions for cryptographic checks.
Given a user authenticates via OIDC
When the profile is fetched
Then their Moodle roles and course-based access control must be properly synchronized.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Defect resolution rate in authentication pathways
